t: What Cold Chain Integrity Database Is All About
title: What Cold Chain Integrity Database Is All About
description: Cold chain integrity keeps temperature-sensitive goods safe: vaccines (2-8°C; some -70°C), food (FDA Food Code), biologics. Breaks (excursions) spoil: data loggers and IoT sensors record; MKT (mean kinetic temperature) judges. GDP (good distribution practice) governs pharma.
